## Vireo 0.9.2
Vireo 0.9.2 adds a new model, **Inkling 2 Mini**, and makes the model picker and Vireo's memory use more careful.
### New model: Inkling 2 Mini
- **Inkling 2 Mini** from Thinking Machines is in Settings › Models, for Macs with 48 GB of memory or more. It's a mixture-of-experts model (26B in all, 3.4B working on each token) that thinks before it answers, and it uses Vireo's tools like Gemma 4 and Qwen 3.5 do. - **Fast on Syrinx.** On a MacBook Pro with M5 Max, Inkling 2 Mini reads a prompt at about 1,450 tokens a second and writes about 50 tokens a second with 8K of context. It got all 14 of our agent and coding test tasks right. - It downloads as one 27.8 GB file (Q8_0), the version Syrinx is tested with.
### Fixes and improvements
- **The model picker only offers versions Syrinx can run.** Hugging Face repositories often carry versions in formats Syrinx can't compute with yet (such as IQ4_NL, Q2_K and Q3_K). They're no longer listed, so Vireo can't suggest a download that won't load. Importance-matrix files are no longer shown as models either. - **Less memory held between replies.** Vireo keeps at most 4 GB of recent chats ready in memory (less on Macs with under 64 GB), and when it's idle it lets go of older chats it has already saved to disk, so other apps get that memory back sooner.
### Good to know
- Inkling 2 Mini carries on quickly in the chat you're in, but its chats aren't saved yet: going back to an earlier Inkling chat reads that conversation again before it answers. Gemma 4 and Qwen 3.5 chats pick up where they left off, as before. - Pictures still can't be attached to a chat. Vireo's engine is learning to see images; it isn't in this version yet.
Everything else in [0.9.1](https://github.com/InvurseStudio/Vireo-app/releases/tag/v0.9.1) is unchanged.
### Requirements
A Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 14 or later. Inkling 2 Mini needs 48 GB of memory or more.
